**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 8.2 and § 8.3 hit the preferred position on all material terms:

| Term | Playbook preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal length | 12 months | Successive twelve-month periods ✓ |
| Customer opt-out | 30 days' notice | Thirty days' written notice ✓ |
| Vendor reminder | 60 days before renewal | Sixty days beforehand ✓ |
| Price uplift | Lesser of CPI and 3% | Lesser of US CPI-U and three percent ✓ |

Two additional features work in our favour and are worth preserving in any negotiation: failure to send the reminder extends our opt-out deadline to thirty days after receipt, and no increase applies to prepaid periods. The ninety days' notice of a price increase in § 8.3 is a Vendor obligation to us, not a burden on our non-renewal right, so it does not implicate the walk-away trigger for long notice windows.
